name: Sreeram Kannan
current_role: Founder and CEO, Eigen Labs (EigenLayer / EigenCloud); affiliate associate professor, University of Washington ECE
profile: Information theorist from Chennai with a UIUC PhD and postdocs at UC Berkeley and Stanford. He ran the UW Blockchain Lab before founding Eigen Labs, the company behind EigenLayer, the Ethereum 'restaking' protocol now branded EigenCloud. Eigen Labs is valued at about $2B, and he keeps an affiliate faculty post at UW.
interesting_fact: He came to crypto from academic information theory. As a UW professor he ran the UW Blockchain Lab and was an invited blockchain speaker at the National Academy of Engineering's 2021 US-Japan Frontiers of Engineering symposium.
deep_cut_fact: Long before EigenLayer he won the 2010 Qualcomm (CTO) Padovani Award and the 2010 Qualcomm Cognitive Radio Prize, took UIUC's Van Valkenburg outstanding-dissertation award (2013), and received UW ECE's Outstanding Teaching Award (2019).
notes: The email is his published UW faculty address (academic, not Eigen). He speaks often at crypto conferences (Devcon, Bankless, Blockworks). Undergraduate degree from College of Engineering, Guindy and MEng from IISc, per iq.wiki (secondary source). Web search budget ran out during this lane, so his personal X handle was not verified.

name: Sun Shijun
current_role: Co-founder and CEO, 认养一头牛 / Adopt a Cow (Hangzhou dairy brand)
profile: Sun Shijun (孙仕军) is co-founder and CEO of Adopt a Cow, a digitally native Chinese dairy brand set up in Hangzhou in 2016 with founder Xu Xiaobo, who built its first large ranch in Gucheng, Hebei. He runs the business, which grew through e-commerce and is valued at about $1B.
interesting_fact: Adopt a Cow joined the Singles' Day 100-million-yuan sales club within four years and gathered 20 million fans in five, breaking into a dairy market dominated by giants.
deep_cut_fact: At DingTalk's 2021 Future Organization conference he explained how Adopt a Cow digitized every step from pasture to sale, including the roughly 25-day silage-harvest window at its Hengshui ranches, using QR-coded field surveys in place of judging by eye.
notes: Mainland China executive with Chinese-language media only. During Wuhan's 2020 COVID lockdown he led a company team that delivered milk to medical workers (digitaling.com, per search summary). No published contact found; web search budget ran out, so the company's official site and IR or press channels were not located.

name: Juan David Mendieta
current_role: Co-founder and Chief Strategy Officer, Keyrock (Brussels)
profile: Colombian-born Solvay Brussels School graduate who co-founded Keyrock in Brussels in late 2017 with Kevin de Patoul and Jeremy De Groodt. Keyrock is a digital-asset market maker and liquidity provider that became Belgium's eighth unicorn, and its first in crypto, at about $1.1B in March 2026. He serves as Chief Strategy Officer.
interesting_fact: Keyrock was founded on the conviction that 'all assets will eventually be digital', and its latest round was backed by Standard Chartered and Ripple.
deep_cut_fact: Before Keyrock he co-founded Kiron Open Higher Education, a university for refugees launched in Berlin in 2015, and Elium, an educational tech organization for entrepreneurs in Europe.
notes: Low profile; CEO Kevin de Patoul is the public face. The press email is Keyrock's PR and Events Manager, named as media contact in the July 2026 press release.

name: Mitch Heath
profile: Co-founder of Teamworks, the Durham-based operating platform for college and pro sports teams. He went full-time on the company in 2010 with Zach Maurides and Shaun Powell. Teamworks has raised about $400M and grown to more than 485 employees through acquisitions, and is valued at about $1B. He is still listed as Co-Founder on the company's leadership page.
interesting_fact: Teamworks began as an SMS-based tool in the pre-smartphone era, and Maurides graduated from Duke with seven teams, including several Duke teams, already on the client roster.
notes: Very low public profile; little published about him personally. Teamworks leadership page: https://www.teamworks.com/company. Web search budget ran out, so the background research was limited.
